text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days after that chance encounter,
a public practice is held for
the
Umamusume who have yet to make their
debuts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
These events are incredibly important for
trainers who want a look at the
up-and-coming talent. Word is that the
new student from Morioka
is attending...

text_block_list.name: Onlookers
text_block_list.text:
Ready... go! Yukinooo Bijiiin! Over
heeeere!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: J-jeepers! Uh, um... Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Didn't mean t'react like that...
F-f'rget that! I need to
concentrate on
practi—Ack!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, Yukino?! Awww, you're such a cute
klutz!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not usually this klutzy!
I'm just not
used t'runn'n on turf, that's all!
B-but I'll
get the hang of it in no time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yukino... You're so cute when you try
hard! This is why you're our idol! I can't
wait for our cutie's debut...
Good luck out
there!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She's a real character,
isn't she? A bit of a
country bumpkin, but hey, maybe that's
why people like her!
She'll drive interest in the Twinkle
Series for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and Inari One—two
Umamusume from Kasamatsu and Oi, 
respectively.
Ever since they made it big in
Tokyo, Umamusume from regional racing
scenes have started to garner more
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among them is Yukino Bijin. Hailing from
the chilly northern town of Morioka,
there's a lot of speculation that
she'll be
the next big star.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
All right,
we're done for today. Your final
task is to share something you'd like to
improve on going forward. Starting with
you!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir! I was really tired in the second
half of practice, so I think I
need to work
on my stamina! I'll try adding swimming to
my training!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Uh, as for me... I was having trouble
getting into a favorable position
in races,
so... I guess I'll try for better spatial
awareness!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Ummm—Ah! My turn already?!
Um... I-I wanna get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-and shine bright! Like a real city girl!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Like a... city girl?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah! I-I... What I mean is...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Bahaha! Well, sounds like you're having
fun, and that's what's
important. Just make
sure you don't skip training!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I-I wouldn't dream of it! Train'n's a
big part of—what I mean by
city girl is—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you gotta be careful, Yukino. If you
don't have the skills to back up your
popularity,
the crowd will turn on you... It's
not easy being an idol.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-that's true. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, a small figure sneakily makes
her way out of the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew... All righty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While doing extra training is certainly
admirable, the dorm's curfew is
fast
approaching. It's dangerous to be out this
late...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch Yukino Bijin run laps up and down
the hills, pausing only to
adjust the
massive weights strapped to her legs.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This train'n's a doozy... But no pain, no gain! I will sparkle like the city girls!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ev'ryone just sees me as an idol,
and that's
'cause I'm too soft! I can't
shine if I burn
out on the track! No way, no how!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's not a real city girl!
I need t'shine
bigger... brighter!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's frustration makes sense.
Her
popularity has nothing to
do with her skills
on the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so she keeps running and running...
With each lap, her
determination becomes
more and more apparent.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gadzooks! Wait,
you're... that trainer from
the other day! Wh-what're
you doing
here?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I getcha... Sorry,
I didn't mean t'scare
you. Don't worry, I plan on
going back
b'fore curfew.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, next up is haul'n tires! Thanks
again for check'n on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All that extra weight is going to do is
slow her down. I tell her there are more
efficient training methods that won't
strain
her body.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Efficiency, huh? I guess I never thought
'bout it like that! That sounds
so cool!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well,
golly... if you're will'n t'give it.
I know it's late, though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-you do?! G-gee will'kers, I don't know
what t'say!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But feel free t'watch me practice! I'm
nowhere near as talented as the
city girls,
but, well... I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Come on! I will become a true city girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! My thighs are on fire! I'll be a li'l sore in the morn'n, but it'll be worth it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(This trainer...
Why're they going so far for
li'l ol' me?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
F-forget it! I need to focus on train'n!
Ready... yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Yukino continues to run along, her
footsteps echo throughout the
quiet, dark
forest.
